name: Hotel Jägerhof
beschreibung: The **Hotel Jägerhof** is located in the municipality of Kolsassberg on a high plateau above the Inntal. Its exposed location offers a panoramic view of the **Karwendelgebirge**. The ski areas **Glungezer and Kellerjoch** can be reached by car in just a few minutes. In the summer months, **hiking trails and mountain bike routes** are available directly from the hotel. The family-run establishment features **alpine-rustic furnishings** and a **cozy guest lounge**. The wellness area includes an **indoor pool**, a **sauna**, and a **steam bath**. The **half board** includes a breakfast buffet and an evening menu with regional products. The hotel is suitable for **holidaymakers looking for a quiet, nature-oriented place to stay**.
